reviews.t: The real thing that lasts all day.
reviews.x: Bought this online after sampling it in the store so I could save a ton of money. I was a bit worried after reading the comments, but I decided that it is more than that they don't know what they are talking about. I was correct. This is no fake, and it does last all day. (Just because you cant smell it anymore doesn't mean others cant. Remember that.) This is one of the best sweet mens fragrances out there. I like it better than the original 1 Million.
Actually the product is not good at all it does not resemble anything the original and the worst of all is that you can not return it. Summing up everything in a few words is garbage.
Smells really good. A few sprays will last you all day so the longevity is there. I love putting this on.

reviews.x: The One Million LUCKY is my favorite scent on my husband. He ran out and I missed the smell, so I ordered more. However... One of these things is not like the other. Or rather, one of these things is like both...  The left bottle is a genuine bottle of One Million Lucky, the center bottle is what I just received, and the right bottle is One Million. reviews.t: EVERYWHERE I GO… PEOPLE WANT TO KNOW WHAT SMELLS SOOOO NICE?
reviews.x: I first bought this men’s cologne “1 Million; LUCKY” By: Paco Rabanne …… last year. I ran out of it about 10 months later. Everyone wanted to know the name of my fragrance!!! ….. men or women!!! I’m glad to order another 3.4 oz bottle! …. Yeah… it’s a bit pricey at $85 ……. But, it’s really worth it!…. You really don’t need much!!…. and…. It should last about a year!! ….   It’s a home run with the ladies!!!!!!😜

reviews.t: Good product at a fair price.
reviews.x: I bought this Cologne as a Christmas Gift for my Son; He chose the type of Cologne, but of course I wanted to get a good deal and not pay Department Store prices!  I'm always worried about buying products like this online, but the Cologne seemed to be the real thing and he was very happy with it...so let's call it a good deal.

reviews.t: It is original and it last allllll day
reviews.x: First of all, people who say this is not original dont know what they are talking about. THIS IS AN ORIGINAL. It is just sold through a third party. It arrived with no issues in original unopened package. The scent last all day and the scent fixes to your skin so well that I can still smell it myself even after hours ( I mean 10 - 12 hours later). I get compliments all the time. Personally the Paco Rabanne line is great all around so you cant go wrong, but Lucky I feel is probably the best one i

This is my new favorite fragrance. It has a very sweet vanilla like scent. I'm not one for the spicy, musky colognes.. I prefer a pleasant scent that doesn't uppercut/KO your nose.  The ONLY complaint I have is that it doesn't seem to last a while. I can smell it on my clothes the next day if I bury my nose in the shirt, but I believe the scent fades away after an hour or two. Still 5 stars for the scent  If you can, go to your local macys or any store that will let you test fragrances. But comp

This would get less than a 1 star if I could give it! I always use the same cologne and all though this is a cologne it is NOT the REAL one that I thought I was paying for! Do NOT make the same mistake I did, they list this cologne as your buying the real one and you are NOT, this is a FAKE!!!!! Sellers should not be able to sale products listing them to be authentic and at the same price! I thought this was against the law!!!! Do NOT BUY!!!

I spray 5 sprays of this cologne, and nobody can smell it. It stays on your body for about 30 minutes and it's gone. The only person that will know you are wearing it is you-- and only because you remember putting it on. I don't know if this is a counterfeit product in a "tester" box, or if this really has zero staying power. I'm afraid to buy it again, just in case this weak stuff is genuine.

I did this one as a blind buy after watching youtube reviews of big beard business and others. I was a bit skeptical about it because you never know what you're really going to get. Anyways it was well worth it smell great lasts about a good 4-6 hours on my skin 8-10 on clothes.
My honey is picky about his fragrances and I loved this and was worried he wouldn't. Well, he loves it!! It's so sexy and grown. He is 1 million to me so I wanted him to feel like 1 million.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the fragrance smells great and draws compliments and attention from both men and women.
Several reviewers report the scent lasts all day with good longevity from just a few sprays.
Some reviewers complain the product does not resemble the original and is a fake or scam.
A few reviewers mention the price is high but consider it worth the money.
Some reviewers report order problems, including incomplete orders and inability to return or contact the seller.
